name: setup
description: Set up a port as controller, bus clock in kHz (port,speed)->()

name: probe
description: Check if a device acknowledges its address, 0 or negative status (port,device)->(status)

name: write_byte
description: Send one byte to a device (port,device,byte)->(count)

name: read_byte
description: Read one byte from a device (port,device)->(byte)

name: write_reg
description: Write a byte to a device register (port,device,reg,byte)->(count)

name: read_reg
description: Read a byte from a device register (port,device,reg)->(byte)

name: write_mem
description: Send length bytes from memory, one per cell (port,device,address,length)->(count)

name: read_mem
description: Read length bytes into memory, one per cell (port,device,address,length)->(count)

name: write_str
description: Send length bytes of a string from start (port,device,src_index,start,length)->(count)

name: read_str
description: Read length bytes into a string (port,device,dest_index,length)->(count)

name: write_read_mem
description: Send bytes from memory, then read into memory after a repeated start (port,device,src_address,src_length,dest_address,dest_length)->(count read)
